info.name: AfriCrew Mobile Apps API Collection (Client & Crew Complete Suite)
info.description:
Complete Postman API Collection for AfriCrew Mobile Applications.

Covers the entire lifecycle for both:
1. Client Mobile Application (Discovery, Booking, M-Pesa Escrow, Contracts, Messaging, Reviews)
2. Crew Mobile Application (Onboarding, Status, Profile Builder, Expertises, Shifts, Wallet/Payouts, Messaging, Support)
3. Shared Catalog & M-Pesa Payment Gateway

Tokens are automatically captured in {{clientToken}} and {{crewToken}} upon login or registration.

variable.description: Target server URL (use http://127.0.0.1:8000 for local development, or https://africrew-crm.databrainit.com for production)
